description: Offline toy runs of proof.md's algorithm using experiment.py's ClassRho. Seeds fixed before the run: instance i of table size R uses random.Random(i*1000+R); target x drawn first from it. All instances kept. v = new states (trail starts + accepted steps) at the first cross-trail class repeat within 4*S_max (null if none); t = accepted steps when the trail that recovered the correct x started (null if none within 4*S_max), so success within any budget B <= 4*S_max is t < B; s = 1 if t < S_max. trails_at_cap counts trails that ended at the trail cap (trapped in a toy-scale random cycle). The budget rule of this claim, S^2 >= 2 (6/5) N ln(5/3), gives S_budget 3,185 (bn) and 2,619 (generic) here, equal to the S_max fields.
